data.name: Gallager
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'galax' meaning 'stranger' or 'traveler'. In medieval Europe, a gallagher was a traveler or a wanderer. The name is also found in the English surname Gallagher, which means 'foreigner' or 'outsider'.
